scope: Read-only audit of frozen title, complete ItemBody and all receipt-listed PNG tiles. Local files only.

diagram_candidates.claim: The next-state and reward are sampled jointly and may be dependent; the state-transition and expected-reward marginals are derived from that same joint mass.
diagram_candidates.draw: State circles, action boxes, and outgoing edges labelled (next state, reward; joint probability); optionally annotate the two marginals derived from those edge labels.

diagram_candidates.claim: A finite trajectory atom mass factors into policy action probabilities and shared next-state/reward probabilities; the target trajectory law is absolutely continuous with respect to the behavior law under the stated reachable state-action support condition.
diagram_candidates.draw: A horizon-H chain s_t → a_t → (r_{t+1},s_{t+1}), with per-step behavior/target action-probability factors and a visual indication that behavior support contains all target-reachable actions.

diagram_candidates.claim: The one-state safe/risky CMDP is expected-cost feasible while the probability of at least one risky action in seven decisions exceeds one-half.
diagram_candidates.draw: One state with safe/risky self-loop actions (risky probability 1/10), plus a seven-step branch/event depiction for no risky draw versus at least one risky draw; label the separate discounted expectation and event probability.

diagram_candidates.claim: Two reward-labelled MRPs have identical stationary feature/reward sequence laws but different state-weighted Bellman-error minimizers and minima.
diagram_candidates.draw: Side-by-side state transition graphs labelled with transition probabilities, rewards, stationary weights and shared feature labels; visually distinguish latent states B and B′ while showing their feature aliasing.

diagram_candidates.claim: With identity hidden-state transition and equal likelihood 1 for the sole observation in both states, the prior (2/3,1/3) is predicted unchanged and Bayes-updated to itself.
diagram_candidates.draw: Two hidden-state nodes with identity transitions and equal observation-emission labels, alongside prior → predicted belief → observation x → posterior, all labelled (2/3,1/3).

diagram_candidates.claim: The reduction combines FTL regret, expert/learner occupancy shift, and expert-surrogate task-cost control to obtain a learned-policy task-cost bound.
diagram_candidates.draw: Flow from mixed rollout policy to state occupancy/loss, FTL average regret, occupancy shift bound, learner own-occupancy surrogate loss, then task-cost increase bound; label the separate terms and assumptions.

diagram_candidates.claim: A stationary policy and the MDP joint reward-transition law induce a homogeneous kernel on E=S×(R∪{0}), with initial coordinate (s,0).
diagram_candidates.draw: A state/reward pair node (s,η) transitioning to (s′,ρ); annotate the transition probability as the policy mixture over action and joint next-state/reward masses.

diagram_candidates.claim: For each state, action values are expected immediate reward plus discounted next-state value, and the optimal value is their maximum, attained by a greedy stationary policy.
diagram_candidates.draw: A compact state→action→next-state backup with reward and transition labels, followed by Q*(s,a) values feeding a max node V*(s).
